Interface ServerConnection

All Known Subinterfaces:
PersistentServerConnection
All Known Implementing Classes:
ServerRMIConnection, SocketServerConnection
public interface ServerConnection
Minimal client-side view of the connection to the server: it can send commands and be opened/closed. Liveness behaviour is added by PersistentServerConnection.
